title: Conserved, explicitly funded AI reward entitlements and claims
scope: Paxeer application specification; implementation qualification is UNRUN.

normative_requirements.requirement: The only reward authority is the market Program's deterministic state transition under the frozen market policy. No reward mint, inflation schedule, token price, capital stake, owner commission, evaluator commission, token pool, swapping, automatic compounding, portfolio, custody withdrawal or consensus voting change is introduced. V1 assigns the full positive-budget worker reward pool to eligible workers. Fees for external AI services or evaluator labor are separate existing agreements, never an implicit deduction from this budget.

normative_requirements.requirement: Funding is an irrevocable contribution by the market owner or the immutable optional treasury principal recorded at F01 creation. The immutable market refund recipient is disclosed in the signed funding request. A contribution does not create individual depositor shares, principal recovery rights or a refundable sponsor position. Attribution of work follows the frozen epoch roster, never the live account balance or live membership at claim time.

normative_requirements.requirement: Use one registered market Program account, immutable asset and seed ASCII 'paxai/rewards/v1', exactly 16 bytes. Derive and register through existing PreparedProgramAccount contracts. The account must have no ordinary operator authority key. No operator holds a whole-reserve private key, assigns ledger balances or fabricates a native spending token. Registration, ABI-version admission, actual source/asset binding and state/transfer atomicity are release prerequisites.

normative_requirements.requirement: All common PAXAI identifiers, request envelopes, authorization and epoch phase definitions come from contracts/core.kvx. Every integer here is unsigned big-endian and has no padding. Amount is u128 asset base units; a display decimal never enters arithmetic. EpochNumber and execution height are u64. WorkerId, ProgramId, MarketId, AccountId, AssetId, policy digest, roster digest and aggregation digest are 32 bytes. Noncanonical trailing bytes, unknown enum values and nonzero reserved fields are refused.

normative_requirements.requirement: A recipient dictionary contains at most 256 occupied slots, each 67 bytes: occupied u8, worker_id32, frozen_recipient32 and reference_count u16. A slot is identified by the exact (worker_id, recipient) pair. Slot indexes are encoded u16 big-endian with semantic range 0..255; values 256..65535 are invalid. This matches each 19-byte claim entry and core C10; no u8 wire representation is admitted. An unused slot is entirely zero. Duplicate occupied pairs, zero identifiers and self-payment to the reward reserve are invalid. References count every retained or active epoch that includes the slot, at most 1,056. A slot can be reused only after every reference is removed by pruning; rotation or eviction never rewrites an old epoch's recipient.

normative_requirements.requirement:
AllocationDigest is H(PAXAI/reward-allocation/v1, schema_version:u16 || chain_domain32 || program_id32 || market_id32 || epoch:u64 || config_version:u64 || roster_digest32 || aggregation_digest32 || asset_id32 || budget:u128 || entry_count:u16 || ordered entries). Each hashed entry is worker_id32 || fixed_recipient32 || entitlement:u128, exactly 80 bytes. H is the exact NUL-separated SHA-256 construction in core C02. For a zero-allocation outcome, entry_count is zero and budget remains the original reserved B; the root proves that exact result rather than inventing a zero budget. Entitlement identity is H(PAXAI/reward-entitlement/v1, allocation_digest32 || worker_id32). Dictionary indexes and mutable claim disposition do not enter either immutable digest. Any digest mismatch refuses settlement or claim with no economic effect.

normative_requirements.requirement: Each Fund request explicitly names the fixed refund recipient and carries funding_policy_version=1 exactly. The client displays that the contribution is irrevocable and names that recipient before signing. Principal identity comes from authenticated host context, never caller-supplied identity bytes. Replay records for the owner and optional immutable treasury are bounded by the common two-actor contract. If treasury_present=0, no treasury actor can fund and no absent-principal replay record is invented. A proposed replacement principal has no authority; the v1 policy version cannot be advanced to authorize it. Funding payload irrevocable_contribution_consent is a required boolean and must equal true.

normative_requirements.paragraph: requires Fund; R10 ReserveEpoch; R11 TerminalizeRewards; R12 DeclinePendingEpoch and graceful close; R13 Claim; R14 ExpireEpochClaims; R15 RefundFree; R16 PruneEpoch. Errors are typed: UnauthorizedFundingPrincipal, FundingPolicyMismatch, RefundRecipientMismatch, WrongAsset, AccountNotRegistered, InvalidAmount, ArithmeticOverflow, InsufficientFreeReserve, EpochAlreadyReserved, EpochNotReserved, FrozenRosterMismatch, AggregationMismatch, InvalidPhase, EpochTerminal, ClaimNotReady, ClaimExpired, UnknownWorkerEntitlement, WrongClaimRecipient, WrongClaimAmount, ZeroEntitlement, ReplayConflict, StaleCursor, RecipientDictionaryFull, RetentionFull, ResourceAdmissionRefused, TransferAuthorityRefused, TransferFailed and LedgerInvariantViolation. Common errors use core C12 codes. Exact F06 extensions are 0x0601 FUNDING_POLICY_MISMATCH; 0x0602 REFUND_RECIPIENT_MISMATCH; 0x0603 WRONG_ASSET; 0x0604 INVALID_AMOUNT; 0x0605 EPOCH_ALREADY_RESERVED; 0x0606 EPOCH_NOT_RESERVED; 0x0607 AGGREGATION_MISMATCH; 0x0608 EPOCH_TERMINAL; 0x0609 CLAIM_NOT_READY; 0x060A CLAIM_EXPIRED; 0x060B UNKNOWN_WORKER_ENTITLEMENT; 0x060C WRONG_CLAIM_RECIPIENT; 0x060D WRONG_CLAIM_AMOUNT; 0x060E NOTHING_TO_CLAIM; 0x060F LEDGER_INVARIANT_VIOLATION; 0x0610 CONTRIBUTION_CONSENT_REQUIRED. CamelCase descriptions above are aliases for these uppercase wire names. UnauthorizedFundingPrincipal maps to UNAUTHORIZED 0x0006; AccountNotRegistered to ACCOUNT_BINDING 0x0019; ArithmeticOverflow to ARITHMETIC 0x001C; InsufficientFreeReserve to INSUFFICIENT_FREE 0x0018; FrozenRosterMismatch to WRONG_ROSTER 0x000E; InvalidPhase to WRONG_PHASE 0x000F; ZeroEntitlement to NOTHING_TO_CLAIM 0x060E; ReplayConflict to REPLAY_CONFLICT 0x0010; StaleCursor to STALE_CURSOR 0x0013; RecipientDictionaryFull and ResourceAdmissionRefused to CAPACITY 0x0016; RetentionFull to RETENTION_FULL 0x0017; TransferAuthorityRefused to HOST_CAPABILITY 0x001A; TransferFailed to HOST_TRANSFER 0x001B; UnknownOrPrunedEpoch to NOT_FOUND 0x0015. Error and operation fields are separate typed u16 namespaces. Native errors retain their original platform values.

V1 common epochs span 128 execution heights: work 64, commitment 16, reveal 16 and settlement 32. Half-open windows and exact opening height come from F01/core. Reservation precedes any accepted work. Reveals finish before F05 terminal scoring, and entitlement sealing is inseparable from the F05 terminal state. Settlement may finish after its scheduled window and blocks opening a later epoch until terminal; late reports/reveals remain forbidden. There is no automatic no-keeper refund or owner cancellation. A lack of permissionless keeper service is a liveness limitation, not authority to confiscate earned budget. Terminal height is the height of that authoritative terminal transition, never an arbitrary supplied timestamp or nominal deadline.

normative_requirements.requirement: Claims last exactly 4096 execution heights after terminalization. Checked addition must succeed before opening an epoch whose eventual terminal-height arithmetic could overflow; terminalization near u64 maximum must refuse safely and enter the common recovery path without losing R. A failed transition never silently saturates. The completed ring retains at most 32 epochs and never evicts an unpaid unexpired entitlement to satisfy that count. One active epoch is separately bounded; pre-opening slot admission ensures its eventual terminal record fits. If old unpaid liabilities prevent capacity release, new epoch admission pauses until lawful expiry/pruning creates room.

normative_requirements.requirement: Consume only F05's immutable per-worker score table. A worker qualifies only when F05 accepted at least quorum=3 distinct authorized evaluator observations for that worker. Its scalar S_i is the lower median of its accepted scores, in integer score units 0..1,000,000: sort n scores ascending and select rank floor((n-1)/2), counting from zero. F05 produces this result; F06 rejects inconsistent producer digests and must not reinterpret quorum as a global substitute for worker-specific quorum. No-quorum worker scores contribute zero weight; a genuine median zero also contributes zero. A still-incomplete F05 state is not an all-zero finalized state.

normative_requirements.requirement: Let eligible positive scores sum to T. With at most 32 workers, T <= 32,000,000 and fits u64. If T=0, release the entire B to F and record NO_ELIGIBLE_SCORE, with no entitlements. If T>0, each exact product B*S_i is evaluated in a checked integer domain of at least 256 bits. Let q_i=floor(B*S_i/T) and r_i=(B*S_i) mod T. Let L=B-sum(q_i). Allocate q_i+1 to the L workers with greatest r_i, breaking ties by unsigned ascending WorkerId byte order; all others receive q_i. Every final entitlement is u128 and sum(entitlements)=B exactly. Zero-score entries have zero entitlement and cannot receive a residual unit. L is less than the number of positive-score workers and is bounded by 31. Deterministic bounded sorting over <=32 entries is acceptable; floating point, saturation, random ties and traversal-order ties are forbidden.

normative_requirements.requirement: Every successful reward mutation verifies the proof-bound sight balance for the registered account in the executing context and requires it to cover F+R+C. The post-transition balance includes the exact staged deposit or payment; sight authority grants no spending permission. Missing/invalid balance evidence is READINESS_BLOCKED or the typed host refusal, never an invented zero. The always-required conservation identity is D=P+X+F+R+C. R equals the sum of RESERVED budgets. C equals the sum of all unclaimed, unexpired allocated entitlements. P and X are monotonic cumulative physical transfers. Each epoch satisfies B=paid_sum+unclaimed_sum+expired_sum for ALLOCATED, and B is released exactly once for any nonallocated terminal outcome. The physical account observation may show an unsolicited surplus U>=0; it never raises D, F, R, C or an entitlement. A ledger inconsistency halts reward mutation with explicit error; it does not assign balances or silently repair counters. Each counter operation and all intermediate sums are checked. Lifetime funded_total cannot exceed u128::MAX; exhausted cumulative headroom requires a separately reviewed successor market, not wraparound.

normative_requirements.requirement: State, replay record, allocation/claim disposition and native transfer effect commit in one real Program activity. No external send-then-mark sequence is permitted. Restart reads the authoritative state; there is no operator editable paid file. Two simultaneous claims for the same entry can produce at most one payment because object-local claim-disposition serialization determines the winner. Two claims for different entries serialize against authoritative state and preserve independent entitlements; no stale client amount or state image may overwrite another claim. Batch claiming is excluded in v1; one transfer per call narrows capability and recovery scope.

normative_requirements.requirement: Score collusion, identity aliases, manipulated benchmarks and false AI evidence can produce economically wrong but arithmetically valid rewards. F03/F05 authorization and aggregation reduce particular threats; they do not prove AI truth. The market must disclose evaluator trust and funding loss exposure. A worker cannot increase its share by a late payout-address edit, fresh deposit, key rotation or account balance observation. A funder cannot withdraw another epoch's reserve. A relayer cannot redirect a payout, skim fees or substitute an asset. Direct ledger transfers into the registered reserve are unaccounted gifts; any future recovery mechanism for such gifts is separately specified and may not sweep R/C.

normative_requirements.requirement: All ten features share one authoritative value <=196608 bytes (192KiB), the common C07 bound. F05/F06 jointly receive 81920 bytes; F06 deliberately narrows its own share to at most 49152 bytes. Proposed bounds fit: dictionary 256*67=17152 bytes; a conservative 33-record upper bound, each 174+32*19=782 bytes, is 25806 bytes; ledger header <=256; total <=43214 bytes plus 97 bytes for the bounded optional last-refund record, leaving 5841 bytes inside F06's narrowed cap for canonical container framing. Treasury identity storage is the single F01 creation/Header option (presence:u8 plus 32 bytes only when present), charged solely to the existing F01 header allocation. F06 stores no duplicate treasury principal, designation/rotation journal or unbudgeted authority table; its already allocated 8-byte fixed funding_policy_version field remains within the 206-byte ledger header. The actual pre-opening completed-ring rule limits the active+completed population further. F05 retains at most its current complete aggregate, roots/cursor and bounded scoring workspace in the rest of the joint section, rather than 32 complete historical vote matrices. Counts and ordered rows must be parsed with bounds before allocation. An implementation may use fewer bytes but cannot silently reduce identity/recipient promises.

normative_requirements.requirement: Dictionary admission is a real finite limit. Before F01 opens an epoch, all frozen recipients must resolve to existing or available slots; if 256 retained distinct pairs are pinned, refuse the next epoch with RecipientDictionaryFull. F08 replacement can still update a future roster, but it cannot force reserve opening without this preflight. All references survive key changes. A retention-limit admission error is explicit, never silent claim deletion.

normative_requirements.requirement: Sustained production operation is blocked until the verified global content lifecycle/readiness prerequisite in contracts/integration-map.kvx I02 exists for this Program profile. Existing Context exposes no free-blob count; guest code cannot promise host capacity reservation. Operator/admission-service preflight is revision-bound and the real finalizer remains the atomic capacity check; a successful preflight is not a reservation. Two new blob insertions per state update can exhaust the shared 512-blob count far before the byte ceiling. Retaining 32 epochs inside the one value does not reclaim earlier value/manifest blobs automatically. Sandbox-specific cleanup is not assumed applicable. Before enabling funding or new work for continuous operation, the deployment must qualify lifecycle/recovery and resource admission. A finite pilot must publish its exact mutation budget and headroom policy; it cannot be represented as continuous readiness. Under contention a native capacity refusal still rolls back atomically and is surfaced for retry/recovery. Pruning application rows alone is not claimed as host blob cleanup.

acceptance_cases.case: late settlement/close: open funded epoch with no keeper through the settlement interval; R remains B, no refund/implicit abort occurs, and the next epoch cannot open. Later valid keeper processing completes the original sealed inputs and allocates once. Closing before terminalization cannot withdraw R. Closing after allocation cannot withdraw C.

acceptance_cases.case: retention/dictionary: 256 pinned distinct recipient pairs and a new frozen recipient refuses opening before accepting work. Thirty-two completed epochs fit; a new opening first safely prunes the oldest if that completed ring is full, thereby reserving its eventual terminal slot. An older unexpired liability cannot be pruned to make room.

acceptance_cases.case: overflow/corruption: funded_total=u128::MAX then add 1 refuses without deposit; forged C inconsistent with sum of rows produces LedgerInvariantViolation before transfer. Height addition overflow refuses without deleting R.

acceptance_cases.case: funding consent: otherwise authorized treasury request naming any refund recipient other than immutable market recipient refuses; an unsigned/inferred treasury identity never funds. Same accepted Fund request replays without a second debit. With treasury_present=0 only owner can fund; any other principal refuses. With treasury_present=1 only the distinct creation-time principal or owner can fund. funding_policy_version=0 or 2 and consent=false each refuse without a deposit or replay-sequence consumption.

acceptance_cases.case: resource exhaustion: simulate actual native blob admission boundary through real execution; new epoch/funding admission refuses before liability creation when no verified terminal path fits. Old claims are never marked paid merely because a host resource is unavailable.

acceptance_cases.case: refund cursor: WindingDown X=0,F=62; permissionless refund(expected_X=0,amount=20) pays fixed recipient20 and sets X=20,F=42. An identical semantic repeat pays zero; altered amount with expected_X=0 returns STALE_CURSOR. A subsequent refund(expected_X=20,amount=42) pays42, X=62,F=0. Later expiry creates new Free but cannot make either old cursor payable again. Missing exact ProgramSpend authority leaves cursor/state unchanged.
